description: This dataset compiles sulfur isotope geochemistry data from various sediment cores and rock samples globally. It includes precise geographic coordinates, site identifiers, and publication references for each entry. Key measurements feature delta 34S pyrite values, sample ages in millions of years, and sediment depths. The data also records environmental context such as water depth descriptions, elevation, and distance from shore. Chemical properties like calcium carbonate and total organic carbon are provided alongside lithological classifications. Researchers can utilize this resource to study sulfur cycling, paleoenvironmental conditions, and geochemical processes across different geological settings and time periods.
